sources.subject: A note from the shop manager

text.clean: Hello. Thanks for handling this so quickly; your support chat was very helpful. Our finance contact is on leave this week; her colleague is covering any questions. The item arrived with a cracked base and the switch only worked intermittently. Regards, Ana (the shop manager)
text.neutral:
Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from the shop manager. When it arrived, the base was cracked and the switch worked only some of the time. While our finance contact is away this week, a colleague is answering questions on her behalf. Your support chat was really helpful, thank you for the quick handling.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Ana
the shop manager
--
This message was sent from a shared mailbox.
